const f:(s:string)=>string|null=(s:string)=>{if(!s)return null;const seen=new Set,o=[];for(const x of s.split(',')){if(!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$/.test(x))return null;const n=x.toLowerCase();if(seen.has(n))return null;seen.add(n);o.push(n)}return o.sort().join(',')};
export function headerNormalization(input:string):string|null{return f(input)}
